cues.ms: Bukan susah pun nak cakap ya.

cues.en: Besides, I owed you a promise.
cues.ms: Lagipun, aku ada berhutang janji dengan kau.
cues.zh: 再说，我还欠你一个承诺。

cues.ms: Aku pergi ambil minuman untuk kita.

cues.check: unclear word "He's"; taken as her sarcastic "He's just your friend?"

cues.en: Then why am I always second to him?
cues.ms: Habis tu kenapa dia selalu didahulukan, bukan aku?
cues.zh: 那为什么我永远排在他后面？
cues.ko: 그럼 왜 난 항상 걔 다음이야?

cues.en: I never meant to hurt you.
cues.ms: Aku tak pernah berniat nak sakitkan hati kau.
cues.zh: 我从来没想过要伤害你。

cues.en: Yet you allow him slutting around you.
cues.ms: Tapi kau biarkan saja dia menggatal keliling kau.
cues.zh: 可你却任由他在你身边发骚。
cues.ko:
근데 넌 걔가 네 옆에서
꼬리 치게 내버려 두잖아.

cues.en: Yes. I did have feelings for Chris.
cues.ms: Ya. Aku memang pernah ada perasaan pada Chris.
cues.zh: 没错，我是喜欢过克里斯。
cues.ko: 그래. 나 크리스 좋아했던 거 맞아.
cues.check: name "Chris" is new (not in EP01-05); kept as heard: 克里斯 / 크리스. Please confirm name/spelling

cues.en: But that doesn't give you the right to downgrading someone.
cues.ms: Tapi itu tak bagi kau hak untuk merendah-rendahkan orang.
cues.zh:
但这不代表你有权
贬低别人。
cues.ko:
그렇다고 네가 남을
깎아내릴 권리는 없어.
cues.check: "downgrading someone" taken as "put someone down / degrade someone"

cues.en: And Chris, if loving me means hurting her, then hear me clearly.
cues.ms:
Dan Chris, kalau sayang aku bermakna menyakiti dia,
dengar sini baik-baik.
cues.zh:
还有克里斯，如果爱我意味着伤害她，
那你给我听清楚。
cues.ko:
그리고 크리스, 날 좋아하는 게
얘한테 상처가 된다면, 똑똑히 들어.

cues.en: I'm not allowing myself to make enemies of it.
cues.ms: Aku takkan biarkan diri aku jadi punca kamu bermusuh.
cues.zh:
我不会让自己成为
你们反目的原因。
cues.ko:
나 때문에 너희가 원수 되는 꼴은
안 볼 거야.
cues.check: unclear: "make enemies of it"; assumed "I won't let myself be the reason you two become enemies"

cues.en: Didn't you hurt someone after kissing them?
cues.ms: Bukan ke kau pun sakitkan hati orang lepas cium dia?
cues.zh:
你不也是亲完别人
就伤了人家的心吗？
cues.ko:
너도 키스해 놓고
상처 준 사람 있잖아?

cues.en: Then hate me all you want, Raymond.
cues.ms: Kalau macam tu, bencilah aku sepuas hati kau, Raymond.
cues.zh: 那你就尽管恨我吧，雷蒙德。
